name: @dreamfactory/speedrun
description: The speedrun workbench, for any game: the sheet language and its parser, the run loop, the drivers that play a sheet in the page or headless, the aim sweep, the panel and the verbs that name no game. A game brings its own verbs and a few facts about itself.
